title: Corner singularities, curved coordinates and Neumann/Robin boundaries
html:
Corner singularities, curved coordinates and Neumann/Robin boundaries

Actually solve singular L-corner P1 FEM, annular variable-viscosity vector Q1 PDE, pure-Neumann compatibility/mean-gauge and mixed-Robin manufactured problems.

These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems.

Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved.

L-corner P1 FEM: grading and separate mesh distortionAnnular variable-viscosity vector PDE MMSPure Neumann compatibility and mean gauge2D mixed Robin MMS and boundary flux

Download and execute the supplement

Run inside atlas-mesh-boundary-2026-11-23 from the ZIP. This command executes all 4 fixed cases in the supplement. The bundled results/ contains stored outputs. Rerun into a new output/ directory, and choose another fresh directory for subsequent runs.

python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m pytest -q
python run.py --input inputs.json --output output

Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it.

    Review scope / review_level: selected-official-tutorial-equations

Annular variable-viscosity vector PDE MMS

Actually solve variable-viscosity stress divergence on an annulus; check velocity, strain, physical traction and work.

Methods used

  • Q1 FEM for scalar diffusion and mapped vector BVPs

Methods used by this fixed-input execution. Their guides describe applicable conditions and the checked scope.

Equations

This example’s formulation and conditions

Mapped polar Q1 with two Cartesian velocity components;4×4 Gauss integration of2mu epsilon uses exact r dr dtheta metric, followed by a block sparse solve. Circular traction uses r dtheta and outward normals.

    1≤r≤2, periodic angle, mu=1+.2r², lambda0 and zero velocity on both circles. A(s)=(s−1)(4−s), u=(A(1+xy),A(x²−y²)/2). Nr8/16/32,Ntheta2Nr.
